title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final answer for the fractional change in kinetic energy.

title: Momentum Conservation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply conservation of momentum to relate the initial and final momenta of the alpha particle.

title: Energy Conservation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply conservation of energy to derive the relationship between initial and final kinetic energies.

title: Mass Approximation
description: Optional Criteria: The student should mention the approximation of the mass of the O-16 nucleus relative to the alpha particle.

title: Algebraic Manipulation
description: Important Criteria: The student needs to show correct algebraic manipulation leading to the expression for E'.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign mistakes in the final expression for the fractional change in kinetic energy.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.
